en: An old black‑and‑white rural scene showing a large, elongated manor‑style house with a pitched roof and several dormer windows centered in the background. The building has a symmetrical façade and a fenced lawn in front. On both sides of the manor there are barn‑like outbuildings. Leafless trees with bare branches dominate the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter, and a rough, rocky, and somewhat muddy ground lies closest to the viewer. No visible captions or writing appear on the image side.
